description: Searches live offers from verified shop feeds in Norway and Sweden. Results are grouped by currency and ordered by total price including shipping; commission is not used. q also reads sizes, ages, budgets and head sizes ('str 33', 'til 3-åring', 'under 5000 kr', '52 cm hode'). Each product has comparison_type: price (two or more independent shops) or single (one shop or one owner), and the card fields image, total, currency, merchant and go_url. When the market asked for has no match, market_fallback names the market the results come from. Shop links are affiliate links. Hosts with MCP Apps show the results as product cards.
